```lean
theorem c03_coprime_linear (n : ℕ) : Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (9 * n + 4) = 1 := by
  -- we prove the corresponding `Nat.coprime` statement using a Bézout identity
  have hcoprime : Nat.coprime (2 * n + 1) (9 * n + 4) := by
    -- Bézout identity: 9·(2n+1) - 2·(9n+4) = 1

      ring
    exact this
  simpa [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one] using hcoprime
```
